g.text: Click chart / interact with room / ask a question
Synchronize one-hour key with current ROCHE
Real reading: chart, horoscope, synastry, etc.
Speak through the existing voice engine
Animate usage; settle debit in RevenueCat
Prewritten education + actual chart + first name
End each answer with a real-reading invitation
User presses the priced purchase button
Wait for RevenueCat grant / edition access
Return to the same atelier and conversation
Renewal grants, cancellation, refund, restore and one-hour key events are defined in PLAN.md.
RevenueCat owns balances and purchases; Firebase owns operational history; Zight holds artifacts.
Prices, exact token quantities and Play cross-app currency scope require explicit sign-off.
